speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL:
text: The Council session has now concluded.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: All assessments and decisions have been recorded and integrated into Arcadia’s long-term policy framework.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The outcomes of today’s decisions will continue to shape Arcadia’s obligations under international environmental agreements in the years ahead.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: What has been decided here will not remain confined to this room.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: It will unfold over time, across ecosystems, communities, and generations.
